plan: <plan id="math-train/2371#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Find the last two digits of the power of 8.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Find the last two digits of the power of 12.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the two residues to determine the last two digits of the sum.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Два независимых остатка; сумма вынесена после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2373#0"><block units="1-3"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count allocations with one nonempty bag.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count allocations with two nonempty bags.</outline></path><path units="3-3"><outline>Count allocations with three nonempty bags.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the counts for the disjoint numbers of nonempty bags.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Три независимых случая по числу непустых мешков; итог после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2374#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Enumerate dice rolls with sum 4.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Enumerate dice rolls with sum 9 and exclude other square sums.</outline></path><conclusion>Combine the valid rolls and divide by the total number of rolls.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Подсчёты для двух допустимых квадратов независимы; вероятность после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2381#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count opposite-side black-shoe pairs.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count opposite-side brown- and gray-shoe pairs.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the favorable color counts and divide by all shoe pairs.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Подсчёты по непересекающимся цветам независимы; вероятность после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2385#0"></plan>
rationale: Зависимость: выбор десятков в U2 обусловлен уже выбранными первой и последней цифрами из U1; двух независимых путей нет.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2386#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Classify triples whose largest square is 64 or 49.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Classify triples whose largest square is 36 or smaller.</outline></path><conclusion>Combine the largest-square cases to count all valid unordered triples.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Случаи по максимальному квадрату не пересекаются; итог после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2389#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Find the probability that Alice keeps the ball twice.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Find the probability that the ball goes to Bob and returns to Alice.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the probabilities of the disjoint routes ending with Alice.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Два независимых маршрута; сложение вероятностей после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2406#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count valid endpoint digits when the first digit is even.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count valid endpoint digits when the first digit is odd.</outline></path><conclusion>Use the uniquely determined middle digit and combine the two parity counts.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Случаи чётного и нечётного первого разряда независимы; итог после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2409#0"><block units="1-3"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count selections of two vowel magnets.</outline></path><path units="2-3"><outline>Count selections of three consonant magnets by the number of Ts.</outline></path><conclusion>Multiply the vowel and consonant collection counts.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Выборы гласных и согласных независимы; внутри второй ветви допустим последовательный разбор числа T.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2418#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count legal rolls when opposite people have the same value.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count legal rolls when opposite people have different values.</outline></path><conclusion>Combine both opposite-value cases and divide by all ordered rolls.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Два случая значения напротив первого участника не пересекаются; итог после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2419#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count all sandwiches before restrictions.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count sandwiches forbidden by each ingredient restriction.</outline></path><conclusion>Remove the disjoint forbidden sets from the unrestricted count.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Общий объём и запрещённые наборы считаются независимо; вычитание после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2427#0"><block units="1-3"><path units="1-1"><outline>Rule out first numbers 1 and 2.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count valid outcomes with first number 3.</outline></path><path units="3-3"><outline>Count valid outcomes with first number 4 or 5.</outline></path><conclusion>Combine the first-number cases and divide by all ordered draws.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Независимые случаи по первому числу; итог после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2432#0"><block units="1-3"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count selections using three Earth-like planets.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count selections using four Earth-like planets.</outline></path><path units="3-3"><outline>Count selections using five Earth-like planets.</outline></path><conclusion>Add all feasible Earth-like-planet cases.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Три независимых случая по числу планет первого типа; сумма после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2439#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count four-digit odd numbers.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count four-digit multiples of five.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the two requested counts, retaining overlap because the question asks for their sum.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Подсчёты A и B независимы; их сумма после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2445#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count card pairs consisting of two kings.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count card pairs containing at least one ace.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the disjoint favorable pair counts and divide by all pairs.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: События не пересекаются; вероятность после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2450#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count starting groups containing none of the three named players.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count starting groups containing exactly one of the three named players.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the two valid starting-group counts.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Независимые непересекающиеся случаи; итог после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2453#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Count rolls whose die-face product equals one.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Count rolls whose die-face product is prime.</outline></path><conclusion>Subtract both excluded counts from all rolls to obtain composite-product probability.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Два исключаемых класса считаются независимо; дополнение после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2459#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Assign offices when neither named member serves.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Assign offices when both named members serve.</outline></path><conclusion>Add the assignments from the two permitted membership cases.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Случаи участия ни одного или обоих не пересекаются; сумма после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2468#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>Find the probability that zero babies speak.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>Find the probability that exactly one baby speaks.</outline></path><conclusion>Subtract both complementary cases to obtain the probability that at least two speak.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Вероятности нуля и одного говорящего считаются независимо; дополнение после блока.

plan: <plan id="math-train/2488#0"><block units="1-2"><path units="1-1"><outline>List Tamika’s possible pair sums and their probabilities.</outline></path><path units="2-2"><outline>List Carlos’s possible pair products and their probabilities.</outline></path><conclusion>Compare each possible sum with each possible product and count winning pairings.</conclusion></block></plan>
rationale: Распределения двух участников независимы; сравнение после блока.
